title: Quest Foglight for Databases extractAndCreateUploadInfoList Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution… (CVE-2026-92187)
description: CVE-2026-92187 is a high-severity vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases involving a directory traversal flaw in the extractAndCreateUploadInfoList method. This flaw allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied file paths.
